added.description: V67 moves VESC's 115,200-baud link off the 4 multiprotocol ports and onto its own separate transmit and receive lines. F13's answer defines the output gate's coverage as 'the 20 output ports and the UART socket' (the 4 multiprotocol ports are among the 20 typed output ports; VESC's new dedicated lines are neither). No return states whether VESC's dedicated lines still pass through the heartbeat monostable's output gate, and selection.json's R4 category assigns a buffer part only to 'multiprotocol port path', 'UART socket path' and 'receiver inputs' -- no function or part exists for a 'VESC path'. If VESC's lines do not pass through the gate, they stay driven when the heartbeat stops, which the page's fail-safe direction (every gate disabled on loss of heartbeat) does not allow for an ESC-facing signal. P5's GPIO budget counts VESC's 2 pins but its combinations/conflicts never raise this gate-coverage question.
